component.name: G13 Control Center
component.summary: Configure Logitech G13 profiles and keyboard mappings

description.p: G13 Control Center detects the Logitech G13 keypad and thumbstick, displays live input, and maps its programmable controls to system-wide keyboard events, and controls the HUD backlight.

Three independent M1, M2, and M3 profiles are supported. Mapped keys work through the normal Linux input stack in GNOME, X11, Wayland, and games while the application is running. The thumbstick can operate as an analog gamepad or send WASD or arrow keys.
Keeps device handling active in the system tray, prevents duplicate windows, displays the version, and adds automated tests and release builds.
Adds left/right analog-stick selection, prevents duplicate physical joystick input, and updates the HUD color picker.
Adds gamepad and keyboard thumbstick modes plus HUD color and brightness controls.
Initial Debian package with automatic Linux input integration.
